messages.subject: Project Harbor — completion call Thursday
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Isla,

Sarah has asked me to set up a short pre-completion call for Thursday 26 Feb at 4.30pm to run through the funds flow and completion logistics. I'll send a calendar invite to you, Rebecca, James and Sarah. Let me know if that time doesn't work.

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant to Sarah Whitfield
